messages:
Ana: Morning — overnight embed bring-up for `cormorant-v2-lite` (int4) shows an affinity drift cascade across anchors. recall@10 dropped 0.82 -> 0.61 on wiki-holdout, silhouette 0.48 -> 0.21. Anyone else seeing this? Plots + raw: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/abc123

Sam: Yep saw the same on staging. Looks correlated with quant profile `qv2-fast` that tweaked clip scales. recall@1 down 0.54 -> 0.33. UMAP shows fragmentation, long-tail queries most affected.

Michael: Do we have per-layer activation histograms? My hunch: zero-point shift at projection head after requant op. Quick run: `python eval/bench.py --model cormorant-v2-lite --quant int4 --dataset wiki-holdout` produced metric snapshot in s3.

deploy-bot: batch job 1722223335 started by Michael — logs: s3://r-inf-logs/1722223335/metrics.json (ETA ~12m)

Jie: Also flagging index changes: last deploy changed HNSW ef_search 64->32. That could make KNN more sensitive to small embedding shifts.

Sam: Re-ran with ef_search=64 on the same int4 artifacts — recall@10 improved 0.61 -> 0.74, still below fp16 baseline 0.82. So both quantization and index tuning contribute.

Ana: Good catch. Can we isolate quant effect vs index effect? Suggest: freeze index params, run per-channel clamp sweep and per-dim bias check. Also compare cosine-normalized vs raw dot-product. If cosine is robust we can normalize as mitigation.

Michael: Started per-channel clamp sweep. Quick note: clamp at 99.5 percentile reduced L2 drift but recall@10 only to 0.70. Command: ```./tools/quant_sweep --model cormorant-v2-lite --quant int4 --clamp 99.5 --out s3://r-inf-logs/quant_sweep/172222/```

Jie: Observed that short queries (<=10 tokens) have much bigger recall drop than long queries. Could be prefix KV caching + microbatching interaction in the runtime. Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-7892

Ana: Proposed plan: 1) rollback ef_search to 64 for onboard canary, 2) run full per-channel clamp + rerun wiki-holdout and web-qc, 3) if recall@10 < 0.75 route high-sensitivity customer routes to fp16, 4) add regression alert for silhouette < 0.30 and recall@10 delta > 0.08. Who owns item 2?

Michael: I can own 2, will push results and a summary in ~2h.

Sam: I'll coordinate canary routing and update the dashboard (will add delta curves and per-query length breakdown).

Ana: Thanks :thumbsup: Please drop links to artifacts and short summary once you have numbers so we can decide canary rollback or permanent mitigation (clamp/profile changes vs fp16 lanes).
